variants.L0: ContactsQ: {provider} sync stopped after {failed_runs} failed runs

L1.what: The {provider} contacts sync stopped after {failed_runs} failed runs in a row, so new and changed contacts are no longer coming in.
L1.why: ContactsQ gave up on purpose rather than keep retrying a link that is not working. It will not restart on its own.

variants.how: Open ContactsQ, then Settings, then Sync, check the connection and re-enable it.

variants.L0: ContactsQ: the contact clean-up needs a look

L1.what: The scheduled clean-up of expired unreviewed contacts did not finish cleanly. {retired_failed} item(s) could not be erased and have been set aside.
L1.why: An erase failed repeatedly, so ContactsQ stopped retrying it instead of looping. The data is still held past its retention date until someone looks.

variants.how: Open ContactsQ, then Compliance, and check the retention status.

variants.L0: ContactsQ: {plural candidates_to_review "unknown caller"} waiting for review

L1.what: {plural candidates_to_review "caller"} who got in touch and are not in your address book yet.
L1.why: ContactsQ keeps them as candidates until you keep or discard them, and clears them automatically when their retention period ends.

variants.how: Open ContactsQ and review the candidates.

L1.what: ContactsQ is running and reporting normally.
